blocks.text: Following Michelle Rose's note, I will have a short brief ready for each interview, so that the person you are lending us sees the themes ahead of the conversation rather than meeting them cold. Each brief runs to a page. I will keep them plain.

For the audit of {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}}, the worth of these conversations rests on that preparation. The coverage gives us the outside view; the interviews give us the inside one; the two belong side by side before I draw any conclusion. Read on its own, either one can mislead.

That returns me to the investor materials. Once they are in hand, I can align each brief to what the company has actually said, so that the Gallegos, Pope and Marsh interviews do not spend their hour on ground the documents already cover. I will send the briefs to you first, Robert Smith, so you can look them over before your people do.
